sentences.en: He has retired, but he is still an actual leader.
sentences.zh: 他退休了，但他仍然是实际上的领导者。

sentences.en: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
sentences.zh: 预防措施比实际治疗有效得多。

sentences.en: I can't confirm that that's the actual number of deaths.
sentences.zh: 我不能确认那确实是死亡人数的实际数字。

senses.zh: 真实的，实际的，现实的；（用于对比主次方面）真正的；现存的，当前的
